title: Adding a mypy plugin regression test case
answers: how to add a test for the pydantic mypy plugin
where do expected mypy outputs live
test a multi-module import cycle with mypy plugin
body:
1. Put the test module in tests/mypy/modules/<name>.py. Helper modules can sit next to it and be imported relatively (e.g. import_cycle_base.py imported via `from .import_cycle_base import Base`).
2. Register the case as a `('<config>.ini', '<name>.py')` tuple in the `cases` list in tests/mypy/test_mypy.py.
3. Expected output goes in tests/mypy/outputs/<config with '.' replaced by '_'>/<name>.py (e.g. outputs/mypy-plugin_ini/). It is the source file with `# MYPY: error: ...  [code]` comments placed after the offending line.
4. Intentional typos in test code (e.g. kwarg `nam`) trip codespell. Add them to `ignore-words-list` under the codespell config in pyproject.toml.
